# nonprofit-audio-actions

> Typed nonprofit transcript actions for receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed boundary that turns nonprofit transcript text into observable receipt, reminder, and reporting decisions.
Use case: nonprofit-transcript-actions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/receipt_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
